name: setup-manaflow-ai-material-look
description: A whole cmux look in Material Design 3 (Material You), the baseline scheme as Android 14 and Google's apps draw it: theme files for color, tone and proportions (Material, the light default, and Material Dark), settings for Roboto on the M3 type scale, the chat's width and the navigation drawer's rows, a stylesheet of cmux.agentPane.style/1 tokens for the shape scale (20 px bubble, filled 12 px cards, M3 menus), and a customize view for a rich-tooltip hover card and drawer rows. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Material sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Material's hover card and drawer rows: an M3 rich tooltip for each thread, Label Large rows and the circular progress indicator while work runs.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
